Design notes 2026-09-04 (design/reverie-design-notes-2026-09-04.md): bootstrap bloat + multi-agent coordination. Nothing decided; claims verified 2026-09-04.

VERIFIED STATE: find = case-insensitive substring + regex on both surfaces (NOT exact-key; no semantic/typo match exists and #13/#43 don't add one). stale = meta.updated age only — flags 108/112 entries here, so it's a write-age signal, not a truth signal; #84 (lifecycle + audit-derived coldness) is the filed extension. "Namespace" = the key's first dotted segment and drives tiers (essential=project/commands/conventions; standard=all but arch), #100 shed order, --size-only, telemetry ns, miss-path calibration, lint schema — a TOPIC axis, not an ownership axis. Per-agent namespaces as key prefixes would break every one of those rules; ownership belongs in meta (#45).

WHERE BLOAT ACTUALLY LIVES: Reverie store 59KB standard / 72KB full, median entry 482B, top 20 entries = 50% of bytes. Tesserae: 241KB standard (conventions.* alone 54KB, never-shed), 114/167 entries >1KB, 35/37 bootstraps since 07-23 shed. Taptory: 2.7KB/entry. This machine raised bootstrap_max_response_bytes 50K→140K, which is why #100 stopped protecting.

MULTI-USER STEP ZERO: _epoch.json (local seqlock) is git-tracked and bumped on every write — 52/53 store commits touch it → guaranteed merge conflict for a second committer. gitignore it or .gitattributes merge=ours. _aliases/_confirm are shared single files too. Entry meta = {created, updated} only; agent attribution exists solely in the per-machine audit log, which never crosses users — the two-records check (project.twoRecordsThesis) has no shared log in a multi-user repo.

RECOMMENDED ORDER: epoch fix → index-first bootstrap prototype (keys + truncated gist, essential tier stays eager, reuse tier/shed machinery; side benefit: per-entry fetches become observable demand signals for #84/tier promotion) → near-duplicate warning at set (token-set Jaccard, WRITE_AMP-shaped, local-only) + lint pass for existing dupes → #84 before any compaction; "replies" (Idea C) should be structured verification annotations (#42/#84 shape), never loaded at bootstrap → do NOT do per-agent key prefixes. Bug noted: --tier accepts any string silently (falls to standard, footer echoes it).
